title: Badge text wraps: "NEW" on Me shows as "NE" / "W" on two lines; text badges do not grow with their text
evidence: harmonyos-home-mate70pro-api21.jpeg, harmonyos-styles-*-*.png (Me tab, all styles)
cause: CYLBadgeView is a child of the icon Stack, which has a fixed width (imageSize, 26 vp); the badge Text is measured inside that width, so long text wraps. iOS (sizeToFit + margin) and Android (wrap_content) size the badge to its label
fix: Host stacks no longer fix their width (tab icon, plus button, demo rows), so the badge is measured with the free width; the badge Text is one line (maxLines 1, no wrap) and its width is the text width + margin, at least its height; the badge width is explicit, as Android CYLBadge.onMeasure / iOS -cyl_adjustLabelWidth: max(height, measured text width (MeasureUtils.measureText, bold) + margin); the border width (twice) is added too, as in PR #801
